property_summary: For any caller address that reports support for the exact string "Nu Token" via Bank(msg.sender).supportsToken(), calling airDrop increases that caller's tokenBalance by 20; the mutant changes the compared string to "NuToken" so callers that correctly report keccak256("Nu Token") will be rejected and airDrop will not increase their balance.
change_summary: Modified supportsToken to compare against a different string, causing supportsToken() check to fail for callers returning the original value and preventing airDrop from succeeding.
